problem_text:
A regional sales director must schedule a series of client visits across five major corporate offices.

The travel times between offices are as follows:
* Office Alpha to Office Beta: 156.8 minutes
* Office Alpha to Office Gamma: 226.4 minutes
* Office Alpha to Office Delta: 151.3 minutes
* Office Alpha to Office Epsilon: 173.9 minutes
* Office Beta to Office Gamma: 171.0 minutes
* Office Beta to Office Delta: 192.9 minutes
* Office Beta to Office Epsilon: 181.9 minutes
* Office Gamma to Office Delta: 118.1 minutes
* Office Gamma to Office Epsilon: 80.0 minutes
* Office Delta to Office Epsilon: 38.5 minutes

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient itinerary that allows the director to conduct a meeting at each office precisely once, concluding the circuit by returning to the initial location of departure.
